hints.title: Maintain Running Balance Counter
hints.text: Increment a counter for character R and decrement for character L.

hints.title: Detect Zero Balance Points
hints.text: Whenever the running balance reaches zero, the current prefix forms a valid balanced substring.

hints.title: Split Greedily at Earliest Zero
hints.text: Increment the answer immediately when balance is zero to maximize the total number of split substrings.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all substring partitions takes exponential time when greedy cutting at balance zero is optimal.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A single pass with a counter variable takes linear time and constant auxiliary memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that splitting at the earliest balanced boundary is always optimal.
complexity.notes: Guaranteed that the whole string is balanced.
